title: Anti‐Neoplastic Effects of Coffee on Gastrointestinal Cancer as Influenced by the Dietary Background: A Cross‐Sectional Study Based on NHANES 2001–2018
abstract: Coffee consumption has been strongly associated with gastrointestinal cancers, but the relationship is controversial. This study seeks to assess their correlation under different dietary backgrounds considering the substantial impact of the food matrix on the effects of bioactive compounds in coffee.
